title.zh: 道德哲學與 AI 倫理：無知之幕與演算法當責 (CEO/首席倫理官 視角)
title.en: Moral Philosophy & AI Ethics: The Veil of Ignorance & Algorithmic Accountability (CEO/Chief Ethics Officer)

slide_title.zh: 合規的極限與道德黑天鵝 (SCQA & The Ethical Void)
slide_title.en: The Limits of Compliance & Ethical Black Swans (SCQA)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：企業正大規模部署 AI（如：招募篩選、動態定價或信貸審核），以追求極致的營運效率與利潤
衝突 (Complication)：科技發展速度已遠超法律條文。若僅以「是否合法 (Legal Compliance)」作為唯一準則，AI 潛藏的歧視與偏見將引發毀滅性的「道德黑天鵝」與公關災難
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議在 AI 開發生命週期中強制導入「道德哲學 (Moral Philosophy)」框架。懇請授權成立 AI 倫理委員會，為演算法植入不可妥協的人文底線
en: Situation: The enterprise is aggressively scaling AI (e.g., automated hiring, dynamic pricing, credit scoring) to maximize operational efficiency and ROI.

Complication: Technological capability has vastly outpaced legislation. Relying strictly on 'Legal Compliance' guarantees a catastrophic 'Ethical Black Swan,' as algorithmic bias and discrimination trigger massive PR and regulatory blowback.

The Ask: Proposing the mandatory integration of 'Moral Philosophy' frameworks into our AI lifecycle. Requesting the mandate to charter an AI Ethics Board to hard-code non-negotiable humanistic guardrails into our algorithms.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，當我們把決定權交給 AI 時，我們面臨的不再只是技術問題，而是哲學問題。法律永遠是落後的，如果我們今天只問『這合不合法？』，明天我們就會因為 AI 的演算法歧視而登上新聞頭條。AI 不懂道德，它只會為了達成目標而不擇手段。今天的提案，是要把幾千年來的『道德哲學』轉化為 AI 的防護欄。我們要在 AI 系統上線前，為它裝上人類的良知。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, when we delegate decision-making to AI, we transition from an engineering challenge to a philosophical crisis. Legislation is perpetually lagging. If our only operational threshold is 'Is this legal?', we will mathematically trigger a catastrophic PR scandal tomorrow due to algorithmic bias. AI does not possess a moral compass; it ruthlessly optimizes for its objective function. Today's mandate translates millennia of 'Moral Philosophy' into algorithmic guardrails. We must hard-code human conscience into our AI before it deploys.

slide_title.zh: 效益主義 vs. 義務論 (Utilitarianism vs. Deontology)

zh: 效益主義的陷阱 (The Utilitarian Trap)：AI 預設的優化邏輯往往是「效益主義（追求多數人的最大利益）」。這在極端情況下，會導致演算法無情地犧牲少數弱勢群體的權益
義務論護欄 (Deontological Guardrails)：引入康德的「義務論」。確立某些基本人權與公平原則是「絕對命令 (Categorical Imperative)」，無論能帶來多高的商業利潤，AI 都絕對不可跨越此紅線
倫理權衡 (Ethical Trade-offs)：在效率與公平之間，AI 倫理委員會必須為工程團隊定義明確的「權衡權重 (Trade-off Weights)」，對齊 IAPP AIGP 與 ISO 42001 的可信賴原則
en: The Utilitarian Trap: AI inherently optimizes via 'Utilitarianism' (maximizing utility for the majority). In edge cases, this mathematically dictates the ruthless marginalization and sacrifice of minority cohorts.

Deontological Guardrails: Injecting Kantian 'Deontology.' Establishing that fundamental human rights and fairness are 'Categorical Imperatives'—absolute red lines the AI cannot cross, regardless of the projected commercial ROI.

Ethical Trade-offs: Between pure efficiency and absolute fairness, the AI Ethics Board must define explicit 'Trade-off Weights' for engineering teams, strictly aligning with IAPP AIGP and ISO 42001 'Trustworthy AI' mandates.

speaker_notes.zh: AI 天生就是個『效益主義者』，它會為了整體的最高利潤，毫不猶豫地刷掉所有弱勢群體的履歷。這就是為什麼我們必須引入康德的『義務論』。我們必須在程式碼裡寫入『絕對命令』：無論這麼做能幫公司賺多少錢，歧視與侵犯隱私就是絕對禁止的。AI 倫理委員會的工作，就是在『商業效率』與『道德底線』發生衝突時，做出符合 ISO 42001 標準的高階裁決。
speaker_notes.en: AI is inherently a 'Utilitarian.' It will ruthlessly auto-reject minority resumes if the algorithm calculates it maximizes overall efficiency. This is why we must inject Kantian 'Deontology.' We must hard-code 'Categorical Imperatives': discrimination and privacy violations are absolute red lines, regardless of how much profit they generate. The mandate of the AI Ethics Board is to adjudicate these exact collisions between 'commercial efficiency' and 'moral imperatives,' ensuring compliance with ISO 42001.

slide_title.zh: 羅爾斯無知之幕與去偏見化 (Rawls' Veil of Ignorance)
slide_title.en: Rawls' Veil of Ignorance & De-biasing Algorithms

zh: 無知之幕 (The Veil of Ignorance)：羅爾斯的正義論主張，公平的規則必須在「不知道自己將扮演何種角色（性別、種族、階級）」的狀態下制定
演算法公平性審查 (Algorithmic Fairness Audit)：強制要求資料科學家在訓練模型前，進行「無知之幕」兵推：若你成為該 AI 系統中最弱勢的受評估者，你是否仍認為該演算法是公平的？
調解與同理心 (Mediation & Empathy)：在處理因 AI 偏見引發的員工或客戶申訴時，運用此哲學框架進行「高階調解 (Mediation)」，化解對立並重建系統信任
en: The Veil of Ignorance: John Rawls' Theory of Justice dictates that fair systems must be designed as if the architects are behind a 'Veil of Ignorance'—unaware of their own future race, gender, or social class within that system.

Algorithmic Fairness Audit: Mandating data scientists execute a 'Veil of Ignorance' war-game prior to model training: If you were the most marginalized user evaluated by this AI, would you still consider the algorithm fair?

Mediation & Empathy: When resolving employee or client grievances triggered by AI bias, deploying this philosophical framework via 'Advanced Mediation' to de-escalate hostility and systematically rebuild trust.

speaker_notes.zh: 如何證明我們的 AI 是公平的？我們引入哲學家羅爾斯的『無知之幕』。我要求所有的工程師在設計 AI 時問自己一個問題：『如果你不知道自己是被評估的白人男性高管，還是懷孕的少數族裔女性，你會怎麼設計這個篩選條件？』如果答案是肯定的，這個 AI 才是真正的公平。當我們遇到因為 AI 偏見而引發的人事糾紛時，我們同樣運用這個框架來進行調解，這能最強烈地展現公司的同理心與道德高度。
speaker_notes.en: How do we mathematically prove our AI is fair? We deploy philosopher John Rawls' 'Veil of Ignorance.' I mandate all engineers ask themselves during model architecture: 'If you did not know whether you would be evaluated as a privileged executive or a marginalized minority, how would you design this algorithm?' If the architecture remains acceptable, it is genuinely fair. When we encounter HR or client disputes sparked by perceived AI bias, we deploy this exact philosophical framework in our Mediation protocols, proving our moral integrity.

slide_title.zh: 電車難題與演算法當責 (The Trolley Problem & Accountability)

zh: 數位電車難題 (The Digital Trolley Problem)：當 AI 必須在兩種損害中二選一（如：醫療/金融 AI 的偽陽性 vs. 偽陰性），這已非技術除錯，而是深層的價值觀抉擇
當責的不可轉移性 (Inalienable Accountability)：AI 只是工具，無法承擔法律與道德責任。必須在架構中明確定義「人類最終裁決者 (Human-in-the-Loop)」，高管絕不能以「演算法決定」作為免責金牌
決策可溯源性 (Traceability & Explainability)：所有涉及道德權衡的演算法參數設定，必須具備絕對的「可解釋性 (Explainability)」，以應對未來的監管審查與社會公審
en: The Digital Trolley Problem: When AI must choose between two harms (e.g., False Positives vs. False Negatives in medical/financial screening), this is no longer bug-fixing; it is a profound moral valuation.

Inalienable Accountability: AI is software; it cannot be sued or morally culpable. We must explicitly architect 'Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)' accountability nodes. Executives can never use 'the algorithm did it' as a legal shield.

Traceability & Explainability: Every algorithmic parameter weighting that involves an ethical trade-off must possess absolute 'Explainability.' This is mandatory to survive future regulatory audits and public scrutiny.

speaker_notes.zh: 在真實的商業場景中，AI 每天都在面對『電車難題』。寧可錯殺一百（偽陽性），還是寧可放過一個（偽陰性）？這不是工程師該決定的事，這是董事會該決定的價值觀。最重要的是，AI 不能坐牢，人會。所以，高管永遠不能說『這是 AI 決定的』。我們必須確保每一個關鍵決策都有真人覆核 (Human-in-the-Loop)，而且 AI 的判斷邏輯必須具備『可解釋性』，這樣我們才能在監管機構面前站得住腳。
speaker_notes.en: In real-world deployment, AI faces the 'Trolley Problem' daily. Do we optimize for False Positives (over-flagging) or False Negatives (missing threats)? This is not an engineering decision; it is a Board-level moral valuation. Crucially, algorithms cannot be indicted; executives can. Leadership can never use 'the AI made the decision' as a liability shield. We must enforce Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) checkpoints. Every moral algorithmic trade-off must be perfectly 'Explainable' to survive inevitable regulatory and societal audits.

slide_title.zh: 100 天 AI 倫理框架落地藍圖 (100-Day AI Ethics Blueprint)

zh: 第 1-30 天 (成立倫理委員會)：跨越法務、人資、研發與專業調解員，正式成立直屬董事會的「AI 倫理與可信賴委員會 (AI Ethics Board)」
第 31-100 天 (無知之幕審查與護欄上線)：對現有運行的 AI 系統進行「倫理影響評估 (Ethical Impact Assessment, EIA)」兵推，硬性植入不可逾越的義務論護欄
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請董事會將「道德哲學」列為企業 AI 發展的最高指導原則。規定未經 EIA 審查的演算法，絕對禁止從沙盒進入生產環境
en: Days 1-30 (Chartering the Ethics Board): Assembling Legal, HR, R&D, and elite Mediators to formally charter the 'AI Ethics & Trustworthy Board,' reporting directly to the Directors.

Days 31-100 (Veil of Ignorance Audit & Guardrails): Executing 'Ethical Impact Assessments (EIA)' on all live AI systems. Hard-coding non-negotiable Deontological guardrails into the model architectures.

Call to Action: Requesting the Board codify 'Moral Philosophy' as the supreme directive of our AI lifecycle. Mandating that zero algorithms progress from Sandbox to Production without passing a rigorous EIA.

speaker_notes.zh: 這是我們未來 100 天的 AI 倫理落地計畫。前 30 天，我們要成立跨部門的 AI 倫理委員會，把法務、人資和工程師拉到同一個談判桌上。接下來的兩個月，我們要用『無知之幕』的標準，對公司所有的 AI 系統進行一次徹底的道德體檢。我懇請董事會下達鐵令：未來沒有通過倫理影響評估 (EIA) 的 AI 專案，連一行程式碼都不准上線。這是在保護我們公司的靈魂，也是保護我們的百年基業。
speaker_notes.en: This is our 100-day blueprint to operationalize AI Ethics. In Month 1, we charter a cross-functional AI Ethics Board, forcing Legal, HR, and Engineering to align at the same table. Over Months 2 and 3, we execute a 'Veil of Ignorance' audit across our entire AI portfolio. I ask the Board to issue an uncompromising mandate: moving forward, zero AI models are authorized to transition from Sandbox to Production without surviving a rigorous Ethical Impact Assessment (EIA). We are protecting the soul of this enterprise.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『道德哲學與 AI 倫理』簡報。受眾為董事會、CEO 或首席倫理官。內容必須將古典哲學降維至最新的 AI 治理 (ISO 42001/AIGP) 實戰中：1. 運用 SCQA 點出『僅靠法律合規』將導致 AI 偏見與道德黑天鵝，2. 探討 AI 預設的『效益主義』缺陷，並引入康德的『義務論』設定絕對紅線，3. 運用羅爾斯的『無知之幕』作為演算法公平性的審查框架，並結合調解 (Mediation) 技巧化解信任危機，4. 透過『電車難題』釐清 AI 決策的價值觀權衡，並強調 Human-in-the-Loop 的當責不可轉移性，5. 結尾給出 100 天 AI 倫理框架落地藍圖，強制要求進行倫理影響評估 (EIA)。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極具人文深度、哲學嚴謹度與對抗科技暴衝的戰略定力。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Moral Philosophy & AI Ethics' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, CEO, or Chief Ethics Officer. Demonstrate an elite synthesis of classical philosophy and cutting-edge AI Governance (ISO 42001/AIGP): 1. Use SCQA to frame how 'mere legal compliance' guarantees algorithmic bias and Ethical Black Swans. 2. Dissect AI's default 'Utilitarian' flaws, injecting Kantian 'Deontology' to architect absolute moral red lines. 3. Deploy Rawls' 'Veil of Ignorance' as the ultimate algorithmic fairness audit, integrating Advanced Mediation to resolve trust deficits. 4. Utilize the 'Trolley Problem' to mandate moral trade-off 'Explainability' and enforce absolute Human-in-the-Loop accountability. 5. Conclude with a 100-Day AI Ethical Framework Blueprint, mandating strict Ethical Impact Assessments (EIA). Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project profound humanistic depth, rigorous philosophical discipline, and an unshakeable strategic command over exponential technology.
